fusions.name: Levelling Blow
fusions.desc: Brings your fist down on the target as a forge hammer falls, dealing 16 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Two-Fisted Pound
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground with both fists, dealing 36 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Rolled-Up Sleeves
fusions.desc: You put your whole arm behind each blow: your damage rises by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Flattened Rivets
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
